steps.what: Develop mathematical models and specify biological assumptions, parameters and input definitions
Prepare repeat model runs and calculate specified biological tracking outputs
Review model diagnostics and interpret changes in biological phenomena

tasks.design: Configure repeat execution in {DATA_PLATFORM} for a validated model and explicitly mapped observations. Model construction, biological interpretation and responses to changed assumptions remain expert work recorded in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeat runs can require manually selecting observations, applying fixed mappings and assembling diagnostics.
tasks.enabler_now: A versioned workflow can repeat the established run specification.
tasks.still_hard: Changing measurement processes, uncertain parameters and biological behaviour outside model assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when apparent changes reflect data artefacts or an invalid model.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeat run preparation while retaining scientific interpretation and model authority.

reach.learn: Model versioning and biological data contracts

evidence.claim: Validated numerical models can be rerun through fixed workflows; repeat setup savings depend on work not already automated.

assumptions: Boundary includes model development, repeat use and interpretation; original observation collection and public-health actions are outside it.

Biostatistician produces equations, parameters, source snapshot, time and location definitions, units, mappings and diagnostic limits in s1 with capture time included. Source collection remains unchanged; missing or changed inputs require manual investigation.
Test native statistical scheduling before custom code. Drift or failed diagnostics stops interpretation for review in s3; no disease alert or external intervention is automatic.
Only repeated human run preparation is removed; existing model computation and runtime earn no labour saving.
unknowns: Frequency of repeat runs versus model redesign
research_questions: Do run logs show repeat setup savings after model changes and diagnostic review are counted?

incremental.description: Run configuration and diagnostic regression upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross20 minus focal upkeep10 gives net10. Range allows infrequent runs, changing biology and existing automation to absorb the gain; development and interpretation remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assign work to biostatistical assistants or programmers after discussing scope, capability and availability

tasks.design: Retain work assignment decisions and record agreed responsibilities in {PROJECT}. No separate repeated data-entry workload is established that justifies automating the allocation decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assignments depend on scientific complexity, staff capability and competing commitments.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing project records can make agreed responsibilities visible.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing development opportunities, quality and deadlines.
tasks.human_edge: Judging who can safely undertake a task and what support they need.
tasks.altitude: Assignment authority and working time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate staff handoffs for analysis tasks

evidence.claim: Scientific work assignment requires contextual staffing judgement; no task-specific labour reduction is established.

assumptions: Boundary covers assignment discussion and recording, excluding staff execution and separate project planning.
Biostatistician obtains availability and capability through existing discussions within s1; no structured skills score or free employee reporting feed is assumed.
Consider native project assignment features before custom code; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the current assignment process remains unchanged.
unknowns: Time spent merely copying already-agreed assignments
research_questions: Is any repeated recording work separable from the allocation discussion?

already_counted.description: Scope clarification, allocation and assignment recording

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Allocation discussions and responsibility recording remain fully counted; no automatic capability judgement is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine archival data definitions, provenance and analysis requirements
Assemble archival data extracts and calculate specified summaries
Analyze archival results, resolve inconsistencies and document limits of inference

tasks.design: Configure versioned extraction and summary calculations in {DATA_PLATFORM} from verified archive mappings. Keep historical coding interpretation, source reconciliation and inference limits with the biostatistician in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeat extracts can require manual filtering, mapping and summary setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit versioned rules can reproduce the same archival analysis preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Historical coding changes, incomplete records and selection bias.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising that changes in recorded deaths or disease may reflect recording practice.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time repeating extracts and more on historical comparability.

reach.learn: Historical code systems and lineage controls

evidence.claim: Explicit extraction and summary rules can be repeated deterministically; historical comparability and the proposed saving remain expert, unmeasured matters.

assumptions: Boundary begins with authorized archival records and ends with an interpreted analysis; archive digitization and original registration labour are outside it and receive no saving.

Biostatistician captures archive versions, date fields, population definitions, code mappings, exclusions, denominators and summary formulas in s1. Unreadable records or unresolved mappings require manual examination rather than inferred structured fields.
Test native database views and statistical scripts first. Savings apply to repeated human extract setup, not existing query runtime or already automated processing.
No new archive-owner data-entry task is introduced; unavailable fields remain explicit limitations or are resolved through retained investigation.
unknowns: Archive format and historical code documentation
research_questions: Can archived analyses be reproduced with less setup after coding changes and reconciliation are fully counted?

incremental.description: Mapping, denominator and extraction regression upkeep
Secure archive access and interface maintenance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65, gross35 minus focal upkeep12 gives net23. Range allows one-off archives, changing codes and existing scripts to consume most or all potential gain; source interpretation remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Design surveys, choosing health constructs, sampling, wording, response scales and validation methods

tasks.design: Retain survey design with the biostatistician and keep the instrument and rationale in {DOCS}. Electronic form construction is a separate implementation opportunity; it does not establish a saving in choosing valid questions and sampling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Survey validity depends on constructs, wording and population context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing validated instruments and document tools support expert design.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement error, response bias and suitability for the target population.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when an apparently clear question measures the wrong thing.
tasks.altitude: Survey design authority and working time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the intended meaning of survey items

evidence.claim: Questionnaire construction needs validity and sampling judgement; generic question generation alone does not demonstrate reduced design labour.

assumptions: Boundary is survey and sampling design, including the validation plan; respondent collection, electronic form building and later analysis are separate.
Biostatistician establishes constructs, population, item wording, scales, sampling and validation requirements in s1. No automatically valid item bank or structured health construct input is assumed.
Consider native document and instrument-library features before custom code; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the existing design method remains unchanged.
unknowns: Availability and reuse rights of validated instruments
Actual time spent in form implementation versus design
research_questions: Does observed design work contain repetitive form construction that belongs in a separate implementation task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Scientific instrument and sampling design remain fully counted; separate form implementation is not treated as removed design work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains scientific and staffing decisions while reducing repeated analytical setup where it exists.
reach: Specify archival mappings with data specialists
Clarify survey meaning with clinical data managers
role.ambitious_version: Use verified repeat-run gains to strengthen biological interpretation and archival comparability.
